name: TrajNet++
summary: 面向行人轨迹预测的统一基准和数据格式，整合多个人群轨迹数据源，用于比较社会交互建模和多未来预测方法。
summaryEn: A unified benchmark and data format for pedestrian trajectory forecasting, integrating multiple crowd-trajectory sources to compare social-interaction modeling and multi-future prediction methods.
scale: Benchmark splits over multiple pedestrian trajectory datasets
scaleZh: 覆盖多个人群轨迹数据集的基准划分
license: Component dataset licenses vary; verify each downstream split
licenseZh: 组成数据集许可各不相同；需逐一核查下游划分
access: Official GitHub resources provide benchmark tooling and dataset preparation
accessZh: 官方 GitHub 资源提供基准工具和数据准备流程
verdict: 行人多智能体未来轨迹预测基准
wmNote: 统一格式和评测协议降低了比较社会导航世界模型的摩擦，但底层数据源异质性需要在实验中说明。
wmNoteEn: A unified format and protocol reduce friction when comparing social-navigation world models, but experiments should document the heterogeneous underlying sources.
